connector.name: Deviceshelf Server
connector.registryDescription: Query your local network in plain language: devices, open ports, security findings and alerts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image deviceshelf-server:1.7.8. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.deviceshelf, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DEVICESHELF_API_PORT
env.description: Port the server listens on; the MCP endpoint is served at /mcp on this port.
